title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — November 27, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.7)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C3.9 (Peaked November 27, 2026 at 18:49 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 369 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Geomagnetic K-index of 4

A broad dark coronal-hole region is visible on the Sun’s right side, while the sunspot field remains sparse.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 193 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
